reserveReview.rationale: The publicly downloadable August 1, 2026 issuer report discloses R$6,177,240 of LFTs, R$878,069 of bank balance, and R$6,039,473 of repos, totaling R$13,094,782. Its published percentages are 47.17%, 6.71%, and 46.12%. All reserves are reported in a segregated account at Banco XP S.A. owned by BRL1 CONSORTIUM S.A. The issuer reconciles them internally to 12,725,909.54 BRL1 at Polygon block 91256109, stated timestamp August 1, 2026 12:59:43 UTC. The report is internally prepared, board-approved and explicitly unaudited; verified review confidence refers to the exact, fully itemized primary disclosure, not independent assurance. PDF SHA-256 5b3eb3a0dba8731947887ef0b66047cef3e361cb7bc980b97d0e5abb09199312. Observation September 5 is not the reserve or publication date. An independent historical eth_call at block 91256109 exactly returned 12,725,909.54 BRL1 totalSupply; two RPC endpoints agree that the block timestamp is 12:59:44 UTC, one second after the issuer-stated observation time. This checks the reported liability quantity, not the off-chain bank balances.
